ts12_embassy.topic: Jerusalem recognition, embassy opening 2018, settlements statement 2019, Latin American embassy moves

claims.text: Trump, 6 Dec 2017: the 1995 Jerusalem Embassy Act; 'for over 20 years, every previous American president has exercised the law's waiver'; delay had left the US 'no closer to a lasting peace agreement'; recognition 'nothing more, or less, than a recognition of reality'; US 'not taking a position on any final status issues' including boundaries; parties to 'maintain the status quo at Jerusalem's holy sites'; Jerusalem 'the heart of three great religions'.

CNN: at the 14 May 2018 opening, Robert Jeffress (Southern Baptist) gave the opening prayer and John Hagee (CUFI founder) the benediction; Romney tweeted Jeffress was 'a bigot' who should not be 'giving the prayer'; Jeffress had called Mormonism a 'cult' and Islam an 'evil religion'; Jeffress: belief that 'salvation is through faith in Christ alone' is 'neither bigoted nor newsworthy'; Hagee's 1990s 'Hitler was a hunter' sermon led McCain to reject his endorsement in 2008; Hagee called claims he condoned the Holocaust 'the biggest and ugliest of lies'; White House deputy press secretary Raj Shah said Jeffress 'has had a strong relationship with many people in the faith community' and was not sure who selected him.

NPR: Jeffress prayed 'We thank you every day that you have given us a president who boldly stands on the right side of history'; Netanyahu quoted Zechariah; Rep. Francis Rooney said he would have chosen a more ecumenical group; ADL's David Sandmel commented.

AP/PBS: Gaza Health Ministry said at least 41 Palestinians were killed by midafternoon on 14 May 2018, including five minors, and at least 772 wounded; the Israeli military said troops came under fire and protesters tried to breach the fence; Trump tweeted 'A great day for Israel!'; the date coincided with the 70th anniversary of Israel's establishment; Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner attended.

Pompeo, 18 Nov 2019: Reagan 'disagreed' with the 1978 conclusion; 'calling the establishment of civilian settlements inconsistent with international law hasn't worked. It hasn't advanced the cause of peace'; the US 'is expressing no view on the legal status of any individual settlement' and is not 'prejudging the ultimate status of the West Bank'; Israeli courts review settlement activity; there 'will never be a judicial resolution to the conflict'.

Honduras dedicated its embassy in Jerusalem on 24 June 2021 under President Juan Orlando Hernández, with Bennett and Lapid; the fourth after the US, Kosovo and Guatemala; Israel Hayom ties it to Hernández's 1991 Israeli leadership course, his contacts with Netanyahu, Netanyahu's request, and Israel's agreement to reopen its embassy in Honduras; no faith reason quoted.

Aug 2022: Castro government's foreign minister Enrique Reina said returning the embassy to Tel Aviv 'has already been discussed with President (Castro)', aiming at 'returning respect for the norms of international law' and 'maintaining a balanced relationship with the other Arab countries and Israel'.

ts12_officials.topic: Officials' stated religious reasons on Israel, 2017-2026: Pence, Pompeo, Friedman, Huckabee, Johnson, Hegseth

claims.text: Pence at the CUFI Washington summit, 17 July 2017: Israel's history shows 'the hand of heaven'; on the embassy, 'It is not a question of if. It is only when'; Trump had signed the waiver the previous month.

Pompeo, CBN interview published 21 March 2019 during his Middle East trip, asked whether Trump might have been raised 'for such a time as this' like Esther to save Jews from 'the Iranian menace': 'As a Christian, I certainly believe that's possible'; 'I am confident that the Lord is at work here'.

30 June 2019: Ambassador David Friedman and envoy Jason Greenblatt broke a specially built wall with a sledgehammer to open the 'Pilgrimage Road' tunnel at the City of David in Silwan, with Sara Netanyahu present; Friedman called it 'a once-in-a-century discovery', the sledgehammer 'the appropriate tool', 'No political message was intended', and his view 'does not prejudge the outcome of future negotiations'; the PA, left-wing Israeli NGOs and Jordan ('Israeli efforts to Judaize the Holy City') criticised it.

Huckabee confirmed 9 April 2025 by 53-46; AP: a well-known evangelical; backs 'Judea and Samaria' usage, opposed two states, supported Israel's right to annex the West Bank but said implementing it would not be his 'prerogative'; said in 2024 he would not call Arab descendants of Mandate residents 'Palestinians'; at his hearing: he would 'carry out the president's priorities, not mine'.

June 2025: Huckabee told Bloomberg he did not think an independent Palestinian state was still a US policy goal; told the BBC 'Muslim countries have 644 times the amount of land' Israel controls; State Department spokesperson Tammy Bruce said he 'speaks for himself' and that the president sets policy.

Speaker Mike Johnson at Ariel, 4 Aug 2025 (per Ariel municipality statement): 'Scripture teaches us that the mountains of Judea and Samaria were promised to the Jewish people'; they 'belong to them by right'; 'It is an integral part of our faith'; visit organised by the US Israel Education Association, designated private.

Hegseth, 2018 speech in Jerusalem (Arutz Sheva conference, King David Hotel): 'no reason why the miracle of re-establishing the temple on the Temple Mount isn't possible'; 'I know that it could happen'; Israel should act while there were 'true believers' in Washington; no response from Hegseth reported.
